name: ism433-pulses
description: Detect every short-range transmission in the 433 MHz ISM band (433.05 to 434.79 MHz) at once: a 16-channel polyphase channelizer and a pulse detector in every channel, the pulse trains as packets.

rf.description: RTL-SDR IQ at 2 MS/s centred at 433.92 MHz

pulses.description: Pulse trains (sdrk_proto::pulses), indexed in steps of 250 kHz
